articles.title: Nvidia, AMD agree to pay 15% of Chinese AI chip revenues to US for export licenses
articles.lede: Nvidia, AMD agree to pay 15% of Chinese AI chip revenues to US for export licenses. (Bloomberg) -- Nvidia Corp. and Advanced Micro Devices Inc. agreed to pay 15% of their revenues from Chinese AI chip sales to the US government in a deal to secure export licenses, an unusual arrangement that may unnerve both US companies and Beijing. Nvidia plans to share 15% of the revenue from sales of its H20 AI accelerator in China, according to a person familiar with the matter. AMD will deliver the same share from MI308 revenues, the person added, asking for anonymity to discuss internal deliberations. The arrangement reflects US President Donald Trump’s consistent effort to engineer a financial payout for America in return for concessions on trade.
